steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup of milk and 1 cup of sugar in a medium bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Mix in 1 pint of heavy cream and 2 tablespoons of vanilla extract.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Add it to an ice cream maker and run it for 30 minutes.
Quickly scoop the ice cream out of the maker into a container.
steps.spoken: Quickly scoop the ice cream out of the maker into a container. A silicone spatula helps, because it lets you scrape down the sides.
Freeze the ice cream overnight. A few hours will do in a pinch, but overnight is better.

steps.instruction: Scoop the ice cream out of the container and serve.
steps.spoken: Scoop the ice cream out of the container and serve. This makes 8 to ten servings.
